## Joining the mailing list

Write to us and we will add you. The list carries meeting times, readings, and
announcements — a few messages a month, nothing else.

[bouncss@example.com](mailto:bouncss@example.com)

## Where we meet

Department of Political Science and International Relations\
Boğaziçi University\
Bebek, 34342 Istanbul

Meeting room and time are announced on the mailing list each term.

## For faculty and visitors

If you would like to give a talk or run a session with us, write to
[Assoc. Prof. Başak Taraktaş](https://basaktaraktas.com) or to the address above.
